meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. Chittambaram Chettiar

rules.statement: An order is not final where it does not finally dispose of the rights of the parties and leaves them to be determined by the Courts in the ordinary way.
rules.supporting_quote: The test of finality is whether the order 'finally disposes of the rights of the parties' where order does not finally dispose of those rights, but leaves them 'to be determined by the Courts in the ordinary way,' the order is not final.
